site.domainNote: volunteer-run neighborhood monthly newspaper with online back-issue archive; current-issue front page

regions.label: Serif masthead with tagline, Text size A/A+/A++ toggle, and top nav links with underline on the current item
Full-width green 'Where you are' bar with CURRENT ISSUE pill, a sentence naming the issue being read, and a 'Browse the archive' button
Issue header (h1 + publication meta) and lead front-page story with headline, dek, byline, illustration that opens a lightbox, excerpt and 'Read the full story' button
Second front-page story teaser (kicker, serif headline, dek) without a container
'Inside this issue' list of stories grouped by section with counts; each row shows page number, linked serif headline, summary and byline
Right aside: archive search box, holiday events list, 'Looking for an old story?' box and 'New to this site?' help box, each in outlined rounded panels
Plain white footer with two sentences about the volunteer production and library help hours

evidence.quote: This Month Archive Search Events Places Contributors How to Use This Site
evidence.note: Top nav bar with seven fixed destinations; current page marked with blue text and underline bar. Not sticky (scrolls away)
Three toggle buttons (aria-pressed); selected one is filled black. Verified live: A++ enlarges type immediately

evidence.quote: You are reading November 2026, the issue published November 12, 2026. The next issue is due Thursday, December 10, 2026.
evidence.note: Persistent full-width 'Where you are' region; color-coded (green current / brown older issue per help text) with 'Browse the archive' action. Wayfinding rather than an alert
Pill-shaped (999px radius) outlined status label inside the green bar
Tiny per-section story counts beside section headings (plain text, not pill)
Photo is a button; live click opens a white dialog over a dark backdrop showing enlarged image, caption and 'Close photo' button; Escape closes and returns focus
Issue contents grouped by section (with per-section counts); each row: page number, headline link, one-line summary, byline; headline opens #/article/... page
Lead story excerpt links to its full article page

patterns.rationale: Sidebar boxes are outlined rounded panels but hold widgets (search, events list, help), not single-item summaries; the second front-page teaser is a borderless item summary that may or may not be read as a card.

evidence.quote: New Gazette Website Opens With 38 Years of Back Issues
evidence.note: Borderless teaser in a half-width column, headline is the only link
Outlined white rounded panel (12px radius, 1px #d8d0bf border) in sidebar

evidence.quote: Try a street, a person, or a few words from the story.
evidence.note: Search form: heading-as-label, hint line, 2px outlined input with placeholder 'Street, name, or words', blue Search button

evidence.quote: A green bar at the top means you are reading this month’s paper. A brown bar means you are reading an older issue.
evidence.note: Always-visible tinted help box in sidebar explaining the color-coded issue bar, with 'Read more about using the site' link
Underlined current item looks tab-like but items are page links (hash routes), not panels
Has text-size control but page is an issue front page/contents, not a long-form reading surface
Only a search entry box; no results on this page

structure.layout: two-column newspaper front page: white masthead header with top nav, full-width green issue context bar, main column (lead story, secondary teaser, sectioned contents list) beside a 340px right sidebar of rounded panels, plain footer

aesthetics.typography: Georgia (serif, bold) for masthead, issue title, headlines and story body/summaries; system-ui sans for nav, kickers (uppercase, letter-spaced), bylines, metadata, sidebar and buttons
aesthetics.typeScale: Strong editorial contrast: 57px masthead/h1 serif bold, 49px lead headline, 44px; 28px secondary headline; 21px serif story headlines and dek; 17-19px body; 14-15px uppercase tracked kickers and bylines; large base size for older readers

notes: Accessibility-first community newspaper: large type, skip link, text-size toggle (A/A+/A++), underlined blue links, 'How to Use This Site' nav item, and a plain-language help box. Distinctive 'Where you are' bar color-codes which issue you are reading (green = current, brown = older), with the help box using inline colored swatches to explain it. Warm cream page (#fbf8f1) with white header, double rule under the issue title, thin 1px dividers between story rows, uppercase brown kickers ('FRONT PAGE · PAGE 1'), page numbers ('p. 2') in a left gutter of the contents list, and tiny section counts beside section headings. Flat-color vector illustration of levee work. No shadows anywhere.
